slides.title: Welcome to Image and Video Generation Models
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **Image and Video Generation Models**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn,

• to define how **AI** models generate visuals from text **prompts**.

• to explain the step-by-step process of **diffusion models**.

• to identify diverse applications of image and video generation models.

• to apply visual generation concepts to prototyping in creative industries.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration: You should have a basic understanding of **Module 2: Art of the prompt**.

slides.title: From Text to Image: The AI's Creative Interpretation
slides.narration:
What if I told you that words can directly become images?
Today, **AI** models can turn your text into stunning visuals.
Imagine you are a director, visualizing a script.
The **AI** acts similarly, interpreting your words.
It translates your **prompt** into visual data, scene by scene.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, text transforming into stunning visuals on screen.

slides.title: Guiding the AI: The Role of Prompts
slides.narration:
But how do we tell the **AI** what to create?
This is where your **prompts** become crucial.
Think of yourself as a sculptor giving instructions.
Clear and descriptive **prompts** guide the **AI**.
They help achieve the exact visual outcome you desire.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, typing clear and descriptive prompts into an AI interface.

slides.title: Diffusion Models: Starting with a Canvas of Noise
slides.narration:
Now, let us dive into a powerful technique behind this.
These are called **diffusion models**.
Imagine a painter starting with a blank, messy canvas.
**Diffusion models** begin with a canvas of random noise.
It looks chaotic, but it is the starting point.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing a canvas of random noise.

slides.title: The Iterative Reveal: Refining the Image Step-by-Step
slides.narration:
From this noise, the magic begins to unfold.
The **AI** model then starts a denoising process.
It is like a sculptor, chiseling away excess material.
Step-by-step, the image is gradually refined.
Each iteration reveals more detail and clarity.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing a noisy image gradually transforming into a clear image.

slides.title: Beyond the Brush: Diffusion's Creative Edge
slides.narration:
So, what makes **diffusion models** stand out?
Unlike older methods, they offer a creative edge.
They excel in generating highly realistic images.
You also get incredible diversity in the outputs.
This opens up many new possibilities for visual creation.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing diverse and realistic images generated by AI.

slides.title: AI as a Creative Partner: Art and Advertising
slides.narration:
With this power, **AI** becomes a creative partner.
In art, it helps generate unique and innovative pieces.
For advertising, it creates compelling visuals quickly.
Think of it as having a virtual studio assistant.
It helps bring ideas to life faster than ever.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, AI generating unique art and compelling advertising visuals.

slides.title: Shaping Worlds: Design and Entertainment
slides.narration:
Beyond art, **AI** is shaping entire worlds.
In product design, it helps visualize new concepts.
For film and games, it acts as a digital set designer.
It brings intricate concepts to life visually.
This speeds up creative workflows significantly.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, AI generating concepts for product design, film sets, and game environments.

slides.title: From Idea to Image: Rapid Concept Prototyping
slides.narration:
One of the biggest advantages is rapid prototyping.
**AI** can quickly turn an idea into a visual concept.
This is like having a rapid ideation engine.
Creative industries can prototype new projects faster.
It saves immense time and resources in development.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, quickly generating visual prototypes from an idea.

slides.title: Summary of Image and Video Generation Models
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We explored how **AI** turns text **prompts** into visuals.
We also understood the process of **diffusion models**.
Finally, we saw their wide range of applications.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
use an **AI** image generation tool.
Create three different images from text **prompts**.
Experiment with descriptive and creative language.
Compare the results.
